lines.text: The LORD says woe to Nebo, and in Heshbon people plot evil against Moab.
Moab's people weep bitterly on the ascent to Luhith, and Moab will be captured for trusting its works.
Moab has been at ease like wine on its dregs, and Moab will be ashamed of Baal.
The daughter dwelling in Hebron is told to sit on parched ground because the destroyer has come against her.
The horn of Moab has been cut off and his arm is broken, declares the LORD.
